meta.title: Luis Castro — Frontend Developer | Angular, React, TypeScript
meta.description: Frontend developer with {{years}}+ years building web platforms with Angular, React and TypeScript. Portfolio, work experience and contact.

hero.name: Luis Castro
hero.summary: I build modern, accessible and fast web interfaces. Over {{years}} years developing management platforms, real-time dashboards and custom applications with <1>Angular</1>, <3>React</3> and <5>TypeScript</5>, based in Los Mochis, Mexico.

about.title: about-me
about.heading: A bit about me
about.bio: I'm a frontend developer and, when a project calls for it, I also work on the backend. I specialise in turning complex business processes — logistics, inventory, IoT monitoring, payments — into interfaces people can use without a manual. I work with agile methodologies, mainly Scrum, and I'm comfortable leading a team's frontend.
about.bio2: I care about the details: clean code, reusable components, accessibility and performance. I learn fast and I enjoy projects where you have to understand the domain properly before writing the first line.

experience.title: experience
experience.heading: Work experience
experience.intro: The teams and projects I've worked with. Today I combine my role at Ochoa Technology with freelance work for Fragmento.

bullets: Led the front-end team, delivering more than 80% of projects on time and to spec.
NAS: monitoring and control platform for feeders in aquaculture ponds. Built real-time data interfaces and integrated IoT sensors and devices through APIs.
Captiosys: inventory and antenna management platform with live data visualisation.
NAS Sim: contributed to the visual layer of an internal tool for testing the team’s in-house devices, built with Python and Jinja templates over HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Sorteos: built and deployed a complete raffle ticket sales platform with an admin module and multi-user support.
Node.js and TypeScript on the backend, Angular 19 with SCSS and Bootstrap on the front-end.
Worked on internal projects under Scrum, taking part in sprints and planning sessions.
Developed and maintained applications with Qwik, JavaScript and CSS from Figma designs.
Diagnosed and fixed technical issues to improve functionality and performance.

Agronodo: field tracking for agricultural engineers with reporting and performance control. Built interactive dashboards with Angular and SCSS, integrating real-time data over WebSockets alongside the backend team.
DoCapital: real-time investment management and visualisation. Created reusable components and validated forms on top of financial APIs.
Creaciones Decorativas Alma and ASI: responsive sites optimised for performance and basic SEO.
Clariti: admin platform for utility payments with chat-based customer support.
WEP: sales and shipment tracking platform with status-based workflow.
Advised on internal projects and trained team members.

skills.title: skills
skills.heading: What I work with
skills.intro: A solid foundation in JavaScript and TypeScript, focused on the Angular and React ecosystems. Comfortable with Git, agile teamwork and debugging problems in real-world environments.
